_meta._source_food: Our World in Data, 'Environmental impacts of food production' (Poore & Nemecek, 2018), tomato/dairy/meat/coffee tables.
_meta._source_apparel: Quantis 'Measuring Fashion' (2018) median per-garment LCA values.
_meta._source_electronics: Apple iPhone Product Environmental Reports (2020–2023 median).
_meta._source_transport: ICCT 'CO2 emissions from commercial aviation' (2020), short-haul per-passenger averages.
_meta._source_beauty: L'Oréal CDP disclosures + sectoral averages from Carbon Trust.
_meta._source_cleaning: Procter & Gamble + Unilever sustainability reports, sector medians.
_meta._units: co2e_kg per unit, water_l per unit, land_m2 per unit. Unit defined by category convention (per garment, per device, per kg food, per passenger-km transport).
